content.what_it_is: MATLAB script plotting eta and sediment concentration snapshots for the FUNWAVE-TVD vessel morphology runs (despite living in multi_vessel_morphology, fdir points at single_vessel_fr_13; L2). Loads dep_00000 (L5), mirrors the half-domain N=2*n-1 (L8), dx=dy=1.0 (L11-L12). For three snapshots nfile=[40 80 120] (L18) with time labels min={'80' '160' '240'} sec (L20), loads eta_, mask_, C_ (L36-L38), masks with mask<1 (L40-L41), mirrors both fields about the symmetry axis (L44-L47), and fills a 6x1 tight_subplot stack (L30) in pairs: odd panels axes(ha(2*(num-1)+1)) show pcolor of ETA with caxis [-0.3 1.0] and title ' Time = <min> sec ' (L53-L62), even panels axes(ha(2*(num-1)+2)) show log10(CH*2680*1000.0) concentration in mg/L with caxis [0 2.999] (L67-L74), each with colorbars and y labels; xlabel only on the final concentration panel (L77-L79). Axis window ax=[0 4500 0 120] (L31). Print statement commented out (L89).
entities: min time-label cell array L20 (shadows builtin min)
unresolved: file resides in multi_vessel_morphology but fdir targets single_vessel_fr_13 results (L2); which run it was last used for is ambiguous
time labels '80','160','240' sec for snapshots 40,80,120 imply a 2 s output interval; not verifiable from this file
2680*1000.0 mg/L conversion factor provenance (sediment density) not stated
dep loaded at L5 is only used for grid sizing; tight_subplot is an external dependency; variable min shadows the builtin
